evidence: Reference is a committed static app: solution/solve.sh only checks no process holds the DB, then `cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/` and `rm -f -- "$database_path" ...` (fresh disposable DB); no npm install, no download, no code generation. package.json pins exact versions (better-sqlite3 12.4.1, express 5.1.0) supplied via NODE_PATH. Seed is committed and byte-identical to the agent asset (cmp solution/app/src/seed_data.json environment/assets/seed_data.json: identical) and read relative to the module (db.js:10 `path.join(__dirname, 'seed_data.json')`). seedIfEmpty (db.js:61-86) inserts users/jobs/applications with seed-supplied ids, positions and stages; application created_at is a constant '2026-06-15T09:00:00Z' (db.js:75); messages/notes take seed created_at; message ids are AUTOINCREMENT in seed order so read markers (seed read_count -> ids[...][read_count-1], db.js:82-83) are deterministic; seeding runs only when users is empty (db.js:62), so restarts do not reseed. No boot-time fetch: grep for fetch/http in src/ finds none; index.html loads only local /styles.css and /js/*.js; client fetch() calls are same-origin API calls. No Math.random/Date.now in the seeding path. Nondeterministic sources exist only for runtime-created, unpinned data: index.js:59 `now = () => new Date().toISOString()` (session/activity/message/note/new-application timestamps) and index.js:60 `uid = (p) => `${p}-${crypto.randomBytes(3)...}`` for new JOB/APP ids, plus session tokens (index.js:88). The public rules say 'Identifiers are generated by the workspace' (hireops_rules.md section 2), and there is no fixed clock in this task: no seed key, rules section or criterion uses a time value (grep of app_context.md and all gate/scored prompts for clock/date/time/UTC/id patterns finds no pinned timestamp or generated id). Every pinned figure the criteria quote comes from the committed seed: functional prompt Z pins Lena's unread 1 (seed reads USR-CAN3/APP-301 read_count 2 of the thread), Platform Engineer Applied order Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi and Screen Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz (seed positions), Noor's note text, and 30-message paging (seed thread_page_size). Criteria refer to records by names/titles chosen by the reviewer, never by generated ids. Ordering of graded lists uses ids/positions (board ORDER BY position, id; messages and activity ORDER BY id). Run evidence: raw-evidence-index.json entries all present with matching sha256, and all 12 matching_source_files hashes equal the frozen task bytes; workspace.json records 'seeded card order and internal notes are loaded' passed and a real-restart check 'restart keeps ... without reseeding' passed (scripted golden observations, not a judge run/Oracle; one run, not a repeated-run determinism measurement, but determinism here follows from the source). Adversarial: a conforming alternative with its own id scheme or real timestamps is not penalized because no criterion pins ids or times; a broken reference that regenerated or randomly ordered seed rows would change the Z pins, but this reference does not. Latent P3 notes (not defects for this row, no pinned value affected): (1) uid uses 3 random bytes with no retry, so an id collision among newly created jobs/applications would raise a PK error (~n^2/3.4e7 probability per review; negligible at tens of records); (2) candidate application list is ORDER BY created_at, id (index.js line ~173), so new applications sort after seeded ones only because the wall clock is later than the seed constant 2026-06-15; with a correct container clock this holds.
